title: JEC Project
description: another vanilla like modpack that has many QOL features
body:
![Pic 1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/89dd1b170a46961c7c153293ad32e277480c62cf_0.webp) ## Features ✨ Beautifull effects - **JEC Project** enhances your Minecraft experience with numerous mods such as [Falling Leaves](https://modrinth.com/mod/fallingleaves), [Particular](https://modrinth.com/mod/particular) and [Particle Rain](https://modrinth.com/mod/particle-rain)
🎤 Voice Chat - with [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat) you can comunicate with your friends and strangers direcly in game
🏃 Armor Poser - customize your Armor stand with [Armor Poser](https://modrinth.com/mod/armor-poser)
♀️ Female Gender Mod - choose your appearance with the [Female Gender Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/female-gender) ## QOL Mods - Armor Hud - Axes Are Weapons - Better Mount HUD - Better Than Mending - Easy Elytra Takeoff - Elytra Chestplate 鞘翅胸甲 - Essential Commands - Freecam - Infinity Mending - Jump Over Fences - Leash Villager - Reacharound - Safe Infecting - Server Sleep - Skin Shuffle - FallingTree - Too Cheap! - Trade Cycling - Xaero's Minimap - Zoomify ...and few more ## Optimized - Chunky - Dynamic FPS - Entity Culling - FerriteCore - ImmediatelyFast - Indium - Krypton - Lithium - Memory Leak Fix - ModernFix - Sodium - spark ...and few more
